User asked (verbatim): "continue" (after the audit; the open question was which findings to fix, and the recommendation was B1+B2 first, then B3, B4, B6/B7, B10, B12, B13/B14, I1/I2).

Context: the internal audit notes. Product decisions taken with the safe default: B1 a set WithURLSigner wins for downloads, presign still used for uploads; B2 clear keys only after the type matches, no key renames; B3 a custom detector is consulted only when the built-in answer is octet-stream, active-type deny floor unchanged; B7 a store/locker composer hook, default unchanged; B10 WithLocation per plugin keeping the random generation part; B14 KMS key ARNs option only (no arbitrary statements).

Acceptance: each finding fixed per the satl-no-hardwire fix mode (interface + one typed option, default unchanged, allow/deny/error-fails-closed/default tests break-verified, docs beside the feature), full gates green, ask before commit.
